newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-IBF TO PROBE EIGHT-MINUTE MATCH.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-IBF TO PROBE EIGHT-MINUTE MATCH.

text.p: world championship mixed doubles match involving an Olympic gold medallist is to be examined by the International Badminton Federation (IBF).

The second round game on Wednesday lasted just eight minutes, ending with a 15-1 15-1 victory for South Koreans Kim Dong-moon and Ra Kyung-min over eighth-seeded compatriots Ha Tae-kwon and Kim Shin-young.

Kim and Ra won gold and silver at the Atlanta Olympics mixed doubles when playing with a different partner. As a new and unseeded pairing, however, they were obliged to come through qualifying rounds here.

On Wednesday, they swiftly dealt with their seeded opponents but tournament assistant referee, American Stan Hales, filed a report to referee Torsten Berg who in turn reported to the championships management committee.
A brief statement on Wednesday night said the committee had received Berg's report and would be reporting to the IBF council, which is due to hold its next meeting on Saturday.
